command.command: if [ -f scripts/release-check.mjs ]; then node scripts/release-check.mjs; else npm run typecheck && npm run build || exit 1; d=$(mktemp -d); (npm test -- --run --reporter=dot >"$d/unit.log" 2>&1; echo $? >"$d/unit.code") & (node scripts/flows-e2e.mjs >"$d/flows.log" 2>&1; echo $? >"$d/flows.code") & (node scripts/e2e-parallel.mjs scripts/app-e2e.mjs --skip-build >"$d/app.log" 2>&1; echo $? >"$d/app.code") & wait; fail=0; for s in unit flows app; do echo "== $s"; cat "$d/$s.log"; done; echo "== summary"; for s in unit flows app; do c=$(cat "$d/$s.code"); echo "$s: exit $c"; grep -E "FAIL|Test Files|passed, " "$d/$s.log" | tail -5; [ "$c" = 0 ] || fail=1; done; exit $fail; fi
